title: Choose which campaigns appear in the campaign carousel
summary: Control which QR Control campaigns a visitor can browse in a connected display's campaign carousel by enabling the QR-Control touch-point and activating campaigns.
bodyMd:
When a visitor scans a display's QR Control code, their phone connects to that display and the mobile store site shows a campaign carousel of that display's QR Control campaigns, sitting above the menu — the other menu items move down below it. A campaign appears in the carousel once it is running on Website or Digital Signage and has the QR-Control touch-point switched on.

Before you begin

  • The campaign is already running on Website or Digital Signage. See How campaigns work: playback strategies, touch-points and status.
  • QR Control is enabled on the display. See Enable QR Control on a display.

Enable a campaign for QR Control

  1. In the left navigation, select Campaigns.
  2. Select the campaign's name.
  3. On the Campaign Brief tab, under ENABLED TOUCH-POINT(S), switch QR-Control on.
  4. Select Update Campaign Brief.

See How QR Control works for the full model, including the mobile store site banner, call to action and pop-up message a QR Control campaign also needs.

Activate or deactivate a single campaign

  1. In the left navigation, select Campaigns.
  2. Select the campaign, for example Triggered Campaign 3.
  3. Next to Status at the top of the page, switch the activation toggle on or off.

Activate or deactivate several campaigns

  1. In the Campaigns list, tick the checkbox for each campaign.
  2. Select Activate / Deactivate Selected.
  3. Confirm the activation or deactivation.

Verify it worked

In the Campaigns list, the campaign's Status shows it as activated, and the Enabled Touch-point(s) column shows a tick for QR-Control. Scan the display's QR code on a phone: the carousel shows the campaign; a deactivated campaign no longer appears.
